timing_basis: First to last runner-log timestamp, including setup and post steps, excluding queue time.
interval_method: 90% percentile intervals from 50,000 circular moving-block bootstrap resamples of paired per-commit means, block length 5 commits. Repetitions are averaged within each commit; they are not treated as independent source changes. Intervals describe the observed histories, not arbitrary future workloads.

cohort_join.overlap_review: At the overlapping commit, both cohorts restore the same cache source and cache keys apart from isolation prefixes, use the same compiler, run the same test count, and compile the same workspace crates. Archive sizes differ by less than 0.001% in both modes. Full-cache compilation averages 55.23 s and 55.24 s in the two cohorts. The later cohort therefore supplies the remaining history after this cache refresh.

sample_selection.sample_description: Ruff PR jobs do not save caches. The aggregate uses the mean of three read-only pairs per source change, with each source change receiving equal weight.
